text_block_list.text: While passing through the central plaza—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hum-de-hum-hum~♪ I wonder what today's 
dinner is gonna be~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan! Bow right there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? O-Okay—
(SWOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hwah...?! Wait, did something just fly 
past me...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No time to daydream! Next, do a turn!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!
(SWOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heeek?! S-Something really is flying at 
me, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's more coming~. Next, take a step to 
the right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yikes, okay!
(SWOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And finally... Your signature catchphrase 
and idol pose!! Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Idol pose?! Uuu, u-ummm~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The totally wicked idol, it's Spe-chan! 
Ta-dah☆
(WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH!) (THUD...!)
GYAAAAAAAHHH!!!!
(FLOP...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What in the world...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was close, Spe-chan. But you're 
safe now! And thus, case closed☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Sei-chan! What was that just now?! 
That weird sound and scream...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Golshi-san is collapsed on the 
ground--?! And she's all sticky and muddy! 
Why'd that happen?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, to put it simply~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
First, Sei-chan was taking a peaceful 
stroll. And then, she spotted Golshi-san 
aiming right at Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah... wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In Golshi-san's hands was a huge stash of 
mud boomerangs! Spe-chan, dodge, dodge~! 
Right, left!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! So that's why I had to turn and move 
around!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup. And in the end, evvvery single one 
flew straight back to Golshi-san. The end!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see, because they were boomerangs... 
Then that signature pose also had a deep 
meaning, right!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that was just 'cause I wanted to see 
you do it. No real meaning at all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAAAATTT?!?! Th-That's so 
embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still... you saved me, Sei-chan. Thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you really are honest to a fault. 
I was just observing the whole thing, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that I've answered Spe-chan's 
questions~, shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But... Golshi-san isn't getting up, 
is she gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san is tough as nails, she'll be 
fine! Probably☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Spppeee~~~ aaannd... Skyyyy~~~? Haaai☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, she woke up.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, running away is the 
best strategy! Let's go☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hwaaaah?! W-Wait for me, Sei-chaaann!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
HYAAAAHAAAHAAA! SHALL I TURN YOU INTO MUD 
DOLLS TOO, HUHHH?!!

Special Week frantically chased after 
Seiun Sky...
